<th class="th" colspan="1">6 Months Ended</th>

<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureTextBlockAbstract', window );"><strong>Notes to Financial Statements</strong></a></td>

</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Equity [Text Block]</a></td>
<td class="text">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">9</em> </b>&#8211;<b> Stockholders</b>&#8217;<b> Equity</b> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Capital Stock Authorized</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Board of Directors of the Company had authorized 560,000,000 shares of capital stock, consisting of 535,000,000 shares of common stock and 25,000,000 shares of preferred stock.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Common Stock</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Australian Securities Exchange (&#8220;ASX&#8221;) uses an electronic system called CHESS for the clearance and settlement of trades on the ASX. The State of Delaware does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> recognize the CHESS system of holding securities or electronic transfers of legal title to shares. To enable companies to have their securities cleared and settled electronically through CHESS, depositary instruments called CHESS Depositary Interests (&#8220;CDIs&#8221;) are issued. CDIs are units of beneficial ownership in shares and are traded in a manner similar to shares of Australian companies listed on the ASX. The legal title to the shares is held by a depositary, CHESS Depositary Nominees Pty Ltd (&#8220;CDN&#8221;), which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the ASX, and is an approved general participant of ASX Settlement. One share of common stock is equivalent to <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> CDI.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> February 2025, </em>a total of 163,935 CDI options were exercised at $0.61 Australian dollars per share for total proceeds of $61,419, net of expenses.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> March 2025, </em>the Company completed an equity raise with Australian investors which consisted of 49,645,391 CDIs at $1.41 Australian dollars per share for proceeds of $42,827,577, net of expenses.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> March 2025, </em>a total of 340,000 CDI options were exercised at $0.61 Australian dollars per share for total proceeds of $130,842, net of expenses.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> May 2026, </em>the Company completed an equity raise with Australian and New Zealand investors which consisted of 32,432,433 CDIs at $1.85 Australian dollars per CDI for proceeds of $41,585,804, net of expenses.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman, Times, serif;font-size:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;"><i><b>Dividend Rights</b></i>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Subject to the prior rights of holders of all classes of stock at the time outstanding having prior rights as to dividends, the holders of the common stock shall be entitled to receive, out of any assets of the Corporation legally available therefore, any dividends as <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be declared from time to time by the Board of Directors. The right to such dividends shall <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> be cumulative, and <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> right shall accrue by reason of the fact that dividends are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> declared in any prior period.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;"><i><b>Voting Rights</b></i>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The holder of each share of common stock shall have the right to <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> vote for each such share, and shall be entitled to notice of any stockholders&#8217; meeting in accordance with the Bylaws of the Corporation, and shall be entitled to vote upon such matters and in such manner as <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be provided by law.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>


   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;"><i><b>Stock Option Plans</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> February 14, 2019, </em>the Board of Directors adopted, and our stockholders approved, the <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> Equity Incentive Plan, reserving 11,418,500 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock for the granting of incentive and nonqualified stock options, or other stock-based awards, to employees, directors, and consultants. On <em style="font: inherit;"> March 24, 2026, </em>the Board of Directors adopted, and on <em style="font: inherit;"> May 7, 2026, </em>our stockholders approved, the Amended and Restated <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> Equity Incentive Plan (the <em style="font: inherit;">"2019</em> Plan") increasing the number of shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock reserved for issuance to 45,150,000. Under the <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> Plan, on the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> day of each of the Company&#8217;s fiscal years beginning in <em style="font: inherit;">2020,</em> the number of shares of Common Stock available for issuance from time to time under the <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> Plan automatically will be increased by an amount equal to the lesser of (i) <em style="font: inherit;">five</em> percent (5%) of the aggregate number of shares reserved under this Plan on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal year, and (ii) such number of shares determined by the Board (the &#8220;Annual Increase&#8221;). The maximum aggregate number of shares that <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be issued upon the exercise of ISOs under the <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> Plan <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em><em style="font: inherit;">not</em> exceed the initial limit cumulatively increased on each <em style="font: inherit;"> January 1 </em>beginning in <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> by the lesser of the Annual Increase for such year or 3,000,000 shares, unless the increase is approved by our stockholders. Certain increases to the share reserve have historically received stockholder approval in connection with the Company&#8217;s annual meeting. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, the cumulative number of shares authorized for issuance under the <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> Plan is 45,150,000 shares, of which 2,940,887 shares remained available for future issuance.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Options are granted at a price equal to the closing sale price of a CDI as of the date of grant, converted from Australian dollars to U.S. dollars using the prevailing exchange rate. Generally, vesting terms of outstanding options range from immediate to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149068038">four</span> years. In addition, some options have been issued to the management team that vest upon completion of certain milestones and performance requirements; as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, 26,393,261 of these options are issued and outstanding. For these performance-based awards, expense is recognized over the requisite&#160;service&#160;period when it is probable the performance condition will be achieved. If at any point the Company determines that the performance condition is improbable, any previously recognized expense is reversed. Adjustments for forfeitures are recorded as they occur. In <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> event are the options exercisable for more than <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149068041">ten</span> years after the date of grant. The Company issues new shares of common stock when stock options are exercised.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The following provides a summary of activity related to the Company&#8217;s stock options for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30</em>:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>

</tbody></table>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company reviews its current assumptions on a periodic basis and adjusts them as necessary to determine the option valuation. The expected term reflects our estimate of the period over which the stock options will remain outstanding before exercise or expiration. As we do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have sufficient historical exercise data to provide a reasonable basis upon which to estimate the expected term, the expected term of stock option awards granted has been determined using the simplified method, which is the average of the weighted-average vesting period and the contractual term. Volatility is based on the Company&#8217;s own historical volatility as well as historic volatilities of traded shares from a selected publicly traded peer group, believed to be comparable after consideration of size, maturity, profitability, growth, risk and return on investment. The risk-free interest rate is based on the yield of constant maturity U.S. treasury bonds with a remaining term equal to the expected life of the awards at the grant date. The expected dividend yield is zero, as the Company has <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> paid or declared any dividends to common stockholders and does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> expect to pay dividends in the foreseeable future. The Company&#8217;s policy is to account for forfeitures as they occur and records stock-based compensation expense only for those awards that are expected to vest.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> January 2026, </em>the Company received <em style="font: inherit;">510</em>(k) clearance under the premarket notification process from the United States Food and Drug Administration (&#8220;FDA&#8221;) for its Vision-MR Diagnostic Catheter and its NorthStar Mapping System. These clearances caused the related performance conditions to be satisfied and 2,088,721 performance based stock options to vest. The Company recognized $772,649 of additional stock-based compensation expense during the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;in connection with these awards.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">No income tax benefits were recognized in the accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations related to this compensation expense due to the full valuation allowance provided on the Company&#8217;s deferred income tax assets.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The performance grants <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> probable of achievement are generally related to the receipt of regulatory approvals or sales milestones predicated on the receipt of regulatory approvals <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> yet received. Under current U.S. GAAP, these milestones are generally <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> considered probable until the regulatory approval is obtained.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Issuance of additional options subsequent to&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;could affect future expected amounts.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>


   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Restricted Stock</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> May 14, 2025, </em>the Company granted 121,260 shares of restricted stock to its <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> independent board directors. The restricted stock vests annually on the anniversary of the grant date, provided that the participant continuously provides services to the Company through the applicable vesting date. The fair market value on the date of grant was $1.07 per share.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> May 8, 2026, </em>the Company granted 111,497 shares of restricted stock to its <em style="font: inherit;">four</em> independent board directors. The restricted stock vests annually on the anniversary of the grant date, provided that the participant continuously provides services to the Company through the applicable vesting date. The fair market value on the date of grant was $1.29 per share.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The following provides a summary of activity related to time-based nonvested restricted stock grants for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30</em>:</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>

No income tax benefits were recognized in the accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations related to this compensation expense due to the full valuation allowance provided on the Company&#8217;s deferred income tax assets.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:8pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The warrants issued in connection with the equity raises were evaluated under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">480</em> and ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815.</em> Of the 3,265,318 warrants issued in connection with the equity raises, 2,100,568 were determined to qualify as liabilities due to the exercise price being denominated in a currency other than the Company&#8217;s functional currency, while the remaining 1,164,750 do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> meet the characteristics for liability classification under either provision and as such are classified as equity under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815.</em> The warrants expire <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149068090">ten</span> years after the dates of issuance. In addition, the Company has 1,950,840 warrants outstanding that were issued in connection with the convertible notes (related party) issuances, which are classified as equity under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815.</em> See Note <em style="font: inherit;">7</em> for further details.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:8pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Any subsequent changes in fair value of warrants classified as a liability have been recorded in change in fair value of warrant liabilities on the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations. The following table provides a summary of change in fair value of the warrants classified as a liability for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30</em>:</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:8pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The fair value of warrants was determined using the Black-Scholes option pricing model with assumptions consistent in methodology to those used for stock options, except that the contractual life of the warrant is used as the expected term.</p>
